final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_event_ratio FROM event_averages) SELECT e.link_to_event, e.avg_ratio, e.avg_ratio / NULLIF(o.avg_event_ratio, 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_event_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
